authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W03 durable foundations + W07 executor plane accepted
defaults.mission: Governed workflow bridge: N8nWorkflowBinding, event/webhook/schedule bridge, credential boundary, evidence forwarding, curated workflow migration and replay-safe execution without making n8n authority/source of truth.
sources: - n8n salvage catalog: 2,053 parsed / 1,937 sanitized patterns

tasks.title: W09-00 - n8n Fabric Coordination & Governance Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate W03/W07 accepted outputs.
2. Freeze ownership, workflow binding schema, registration lifecycle and safe execution topology.
3. Define what remains in Aurora vs n8n and enforce Aurora as source of truth.
4. Define publication barriers and migration acceptance categories.
5. Create risk/premortem for webhook replay, credential leakage, duplicate execution and shell/SSH patterns.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create authority logic inside n8n or implement device/provider executors.

tasks.title: W09-A - N8nWorkflowBinding Registry
actions: 1. Define N8nWorkflowBinding with workflow reference, version/hash, provenance, tenant scope, capability binding and status.
2. Support immutable/versioned registration and supersession.
3. Record sanitized source lineage where migrated from corpus.
4. Reject unknown/stale/incompatible bindings.
5. Add registry/schema/consumer tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not copy raw corpus credentials/pinData/IDs into canonical bindings.

tasks.title: W09-B - Event/Webhook/Schedule Bridge
actions: 1. Implement event, webhook and schedule ingress/egress bridge using W03 semantics.
2. Propagate correlation/causation/idempotency.
3. Deduplicate webhook/event replay.
4. Map scheduled triggers to governed execution requests rather than direct side effects.
5. Add duplicate/out-of-order/replay tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not bypass W07 for side effects.

tasks.title: W09-C - Workflow Credential Boundary
actions: 1. Define how n8n workflow credentials reference external secrets without becoming Aurora authority.
2. Bind credential use to tenant/workflow/provider context.
3. Prevent credential values from Evidence, logs, templates or bindings.
4. Define rotation/revocation handling where supported.
5. Test wrong-tenant and missing-secret fail closed.
tasks.forbidden: Do not make n8n credential possession permission to execute.

tasks.title: W09-D - Receipt/Evidence Forwarding
actions: 1. Forward workflow run status, outputs, target execution receipts and evidence references into Aurora correlation chain.
2. Normalize workflow started/completed/failed/cancelled/uncertain outcomes.
3. Preserve provenance/version/hash.
4. Prevent private/sensitive workflow data from entering governance evidence.
5. Add reconstruction tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not create a parallel evidence source of truth.

tasks.title: W09-E - Curated Workflow Migration
actions: 1. Use the sanitized 1,937-pattern corpus only as reference.
2. Classify candidate workflows by capability/domain/risk/provenance.
3. Re-specify smallest useful topology against W03/W07/W08 contracts.
4. Keep 32 Execute Command/SSH examples index-only high-risk unless a future explicitly governed LOCAL_SERVICE capability is approved.
5. Record source hash/provenance and licensing checks for any verbatim reuse.
tasks.forbidden: Do not bulk import raw workflow corpus into production.

tasks.title: W09-F - Governance, Replay, Failure & Integration Tests
actions: 1. Test workflow registration/version drift, duplicate webhooks/events, retries, cancellation, provider outage, missing credential and evidence forwarding.
2. Prove no workflow node can mint authority or directly bypass W07.
3. Run load/fan-out budgets and four Risk Gates.
4. Run exact-head CI and cleanup.
5. Publish accepted W09 fabric handoff.
tasks.forbidden: Do not claim domain workflow completion for W10-W13.
